remarks: Spacious 3 bd, 2.5 ba townhouse within walking distance to downtown New Canaan and train. EIK, granite, tile backsplash, hardwood floors throughout. Open living room/dining room. Gas fireplace and sliders that open to a flagstone patio that looks over the Five Mile River. Large side yard. Master with full bath, walk in closet, bonus room above garage. Ample storage in the unfinished full basement, and attic. Professional landlord, on a well, no water utility. A pet is negotiable. 3 hr advance needed for appoinments. Credit check needed, good credit a must. Must have confirmed appt.
